credits.holder: Jakob Eyermann, with Susanne M. Hoffmann (painter not named)
credits.work: Illustrations of the Stellarium sky culture 'Norse (Edda)' (skycultures/norse_edda/illustrations)
credits.note: Licence line of the culture's description: 'CC BY 4.0'; credit as written there: contributed to Stellarium by Jakob Eyermann consulting with Susanne M. Hoffmann. Stellarium main repository commit e233fa9b3d21e2cafe9c168e6710b627532a7dd4. Changes: background removed, converted to line/tone (ink coverage and a drawing-order channel, no colour), resampled onto the sky with the culture's own three-star anchors. Figures: edAsr, edBif, edFrS, edFrV, edHeim, edHra, edMim, edOxH, edRat, edSer, edThV, edThi, edThor, edToe, edUrd, edVan. edVan holds the whole wolf-and-river painting, including the wolf's jaw of edUlf.

credits.work: Stick lines of the Stellarium sky culture 'Norse', carried in the figure files edThV, edFrV, edAsr, edToe
credits.note: Licence line of the 'norse' culture: 'CC BY-SA 4.0'. The Edda description says: 'Several constellations were taken from the Rimtol gloss and thus from Jonas Persson's sky culture Norse'. The 'norse' culture has no drawings; share-alike applies to these figure files because they carry its lines. Changes: pen order; end points looked up again (within 0.003 deg; the viewer draws the culture's lines).
